label: There is something maximally being…, from Grades are found in things: some things are… and 3 more
meaning: ST I q.2 a.3 co., the quarta via: grades of truth have a maximum, the maximally true is maximally being, and the maximum in a genus causes all in it; so something maximal in being causes the being of every other being. Only 'causa esse' is derived, not 'et bonitatis, et cuiuslibet perfectionis'. The Comparator config also verifies quartaViaNeedsMaximum: on an unbounded gradation the other premises hold and the conclusion fails.
